status: milestone1: release contract for wild levels and Alpha. Packaging readiness is recorded separately in HANDOFF.json ready_for_ui; every known unreleased UI tier is rejected by settingsFromUi.

generator.name: rando-v3
generator.ui_release_gate: settingsFromUi rejects known tiers not released here; direct Settings accepts experimental algorithms for host research only.

wild_mode.notes: off = original wild table; random = today's seeded species per slot with the early-Rock guard, authored move-set rows and story rows kept.

wild_levels.notes: Base encounter min/max levels only. +10/+25 percent round half up and clamp to 1..100; range independently draws each endpoint within +/-5 then sorts; mixed maps level-ordered slots to another zone in the same zone class. Both early Rock-provider slots (including z659_tuto) stay vanilla outside Chaos. Spawner additionalLevel and Alpha additional levels are unchanged.

wild_mega_rate.notes: No probability field exists for wild Megas (research 31.10 s.3.1); only the 23 existing Mega slots can be Megas. Not planned for v3.

alpha_rate.notes: Scale only original nonzero Alpha probabilities, capped at 100. Always=100 for those eligible slots, not slots with original p=0. Fixed quest Alphas (100), all boss rows, and the two early Rock-provider chances stay unchanged outside Chaos. Alpha level bonuses stay unchanged. This narrows the research report all-non-boss suggestion to the approved UI wording: every slot that can be an Alpha.

held_items.notes: Wild holdItem is an absent sub-table in all 1,822 rows. The reconstructed fb_codec decodes existing scalar fields and discovers offsets; it has no general tree encoder. Adding these sub-tables is outside this milestone.

trainers_mode.notes: random = today's seeded species per slot with learnset moves by level; Mega stones removed from non-Mega slots.

starter_mode.notes: The generator accepts any species of the 343 validated city-starter templates; vanilla and any are UI lists over that pool.

starter_pick.value: species number (national dex id) or null when starter_mode = random
starter_pick.notes: All nine are present in starter-deltas.json (verified 31.10).

starter_level.notes: Fixed by the starting-save template. Not planned for v3.

music.owner: port/rando-music (r29): randomizeMusic() runs after the generator, not inside it.

player_name.owner: port/rando-v2 (nameRun / za_player_name): runs after the generator, not inside it.

starting_money.notes: Save-template write (KMoney block); not in v3 scope.

shiny_default.notes: Launcher writes the selected index to the new run cheats.txt (za-cheats-v2); overlay applies it. Generator parser passes this launcher-owned value through without changing table settings.

capture_default.notes: Launcher writes the selected index to the new run cheats.txt (za-cheats-v2); overlay applies it. Generator parser passes this launcher-owned value through without changing table settings.

fps_counter_default.notes: cheats.txt write at run creation; launcher-side.

base_stats.notes: Not in ui_model.cpp yet. personal_array.bin field 20 (6 x u8) in place; needs a new run table (avalon/data/personal_array.bin).

catch_rate.notes: Not in ui_model.cpp yet. personal_array.bin field 9 (u8) in place; same new table as base_stats.

start_point.notes: port/skip-intro (branch skip-intro). chapter4 = the run's starting save is moved to the start of chapter 4 (phase 40100): story flags/quests of chapters 1-3, Royale rank V with cap V, Mega Ring equipped, apps/map/fast travel, starter at Lv 30 + the chapter-3 Absol gift (Lv 30), money 30000, balls/medicine. Needs chapter4-start.json (za-chapter4-start-v1) in randomizer-assets; tables are unchanged. Not in ui_model.cpp yet; PC-proven only, no console test.

planned_extra.name: personal
planned_extra.notes: Only when base_stats or catch_rate is not vanilla; recorded like native_music so r27b/r28/r29 binaries still list the run.

report_json.options: legacy booleans kept: wild, trainers, mega_trainers, dlc_rematches, research_rewards
report_json.v3: resolved settings and per-table summaries (added when the v3 generator produces the run)
